newsitem.title: USA: Shareholder urges Metricom to make change.
newsitem.headline: Shareholder urges Metricom to make change.

text.p: Ryback Management Corp said Friday it presented Metricom Inc's stock board with a proxy proposal recommending changes that would maximize the stock's value.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Ryback said the most effective way to maximize the stock's value is for Metricom to consider a sale, merger or other business combination of Metricom to or with another company.
In its proxy proposal, presented to Metricom on December 26, Ryback recommended that the board "take all actions necessary to conduct a competitive auction" for Metricom's business and/or assets.
Ryback holds a 27.4 percent stake in Metricom or 4,112,891 common shares and originally acquired the stake for investment purposes.
The Los Gatos, Calif, company is a leader in digital wireless data communications networking technology.
